**Source Repo:** https://github.com/dmccreary/information-systems/tree/main/docs/sims/stakeholder-power-interest-grid Reused from the cross-book MicroSim catalog (WHAT match score 0.8463, verified live). An interactive 2x2 power-interest grid with draggable stakeholder dots, attitude coloring (supportive, neutral, opposed), and a what-if scenario control. Learning objective: given a set of stakeholders in a system-design scenario, the learner will classify each one by power and interest and justify a prioritized engagement strategy for each quadrant (Bloom: Analyzing).
